title: Beloved
synopsis: Ohio, after the war. 124 is haunted. Your past walks up the road one day and sits on the porch and asks for water.

nodes.text: The house is, as the town says, spiteful.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.
“Move” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.sceneTitle: The Story Will Not Pass On

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You and Paul D, slowly, learn each other again. The porch is, by spring, full of bread and visitors.
Denver becomes, in time, a teacher. She moves into town. You visit. You watch her speak to children and feel, finally, a kind of pride that doesn't ache.
Beloved's name fades from the town's stories. Yours does not. The book gets written. The book gets read. A century later it is, by some readers, a kind of altar.
